target: P(NWS CLI daily precipitation > 0.00 in) at the contract CLI site over the local-standard-time climate day; trace = NO
inputs: NWS GFS MOS (MAV) 6-h PoP for the CLI window, latest run published before the cutoff (runtime + 5 h)

comparable_conditions.definition: Past days at the same station (2023-01..2025-06, run ~18 h before the window) whose MOS window PoP fell in the same 10-point bin; observed share with measurable CLI precipitation
